meta.component: Website chat assistant (ChatWidget) + live slot availability in the booking form
meta.status: Implemented in this commit. This spec is the contract to keep it working.
meta.model: Unnamed assistant. Answers from a Notion knowledge base, checks free times in Velure Bookings, shows a Book button that opens the booking panel prefilled, and turns questions it cannot answer into contact requests. It never books on its own.

flow: Browser ChatWidget → POST /api/chat (same origin) { sessionId, message }
/api/chat checks Origin, validates, rate-limits (Upstash, optional), forwards to n8n with header X-Velure-Secret

n8n 'Velure Chat Assistant': Validate & Limit → Notion KB + System Prompt (10 min cache) → AI Agent (Claude Haiku, memory per sessionId, 3 tools) → Format Reply → { reply, action? } → log to Velure Chat Logs
Tools are sub-workflows: check_availability → 'Velure — Availability', suggest_booking → 'Velure Chat — Booking Link', save_contact_request → 'Velure Chat — Contact Request'
Booking form → GET n8n 'velure-availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD' → taken times are disabled before submit (409 check on submit stays)
architecture.why_server_route: The chat calls a paid model, so the n8n URL, its secret and the rate limits stay on the server. The other forms keep posting to n8n directly.

response.reply: plain text, may contain \n; URLs, emails and (480) 555-0142 are linkified
response.action: optional { type: 'book', treatmentId, date: 'YYYY-MM-DD' | null, time: 'HH:mm' | null }. Present only when suggest_booking returned ok. Whitelisted again in src/lib/chat.ts (parseBookingAction) on the server and the client.

contract.status_codes: 200 reply · 400 invalid input · 403 bad origin · 429 rate limited (route or n8n caps) · 500/502 assistant unavailable. All carry { reply } so the widget always shows a message.

files.src/app/api/chat/route.ts: Origin check (localhost:3000, https://velure-medspa*.vercel.app, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, CHAT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS), Upstash limits 10/min/IP, 60/day/IP, 30/day/session (fail open), 30 s upstream timeout.
files.src/components/chat/ChatWidget.tsx: Launcher + panel. Mounted in layout.tsx inside BookingProvider.
files.src/components/forms/BookingForm.tsx: prefill prop (wins over a saved draft) + live taken times per date; a prefilled time that is taken is cleared with the existing slot_taken message.

launcher.position: fixed bottom-6, right var(--gutter), 56px circle, espresso with gold-light/40 hairline, ivory MessageCircle icon (stroke 1.25), hover gold. z-40 (under the Sheet overlay, mobile menu, nav and preloader).
launcher.visibility: Hidden while the hero (#top) is more than 35% in view (the hero owns that corner with the scroll cue) and while the booking panel is open. Fades/slides in 0.5s; no motion with reduced motion.

panel.desktop: 392px wide, max 600px tall, above the launcher, ivory, stone border, radius 24px, shadow-soft. Launcher turns into a close button.
panel.mobile_max_639px: Full screen above the nav (z-90), follows visualViewport so the input sits on the keyboard, page scroll paused (lenis.stop + html[data-chat-open] overflow hidden).
panel.header: Eyebrow 'Velure Med Spa' (gold) + Fraunces 'Questions, welcome.' + round close button.
panel.messages: Assistant: sand bubble. Visitor: espresso bubble, ivory text. Typing: three pulsing dots.
panel.greeting: Hello. I can help with treatments, prices and free appointment times, and open the booking panel for you. What would you like to know?
panel.book_button: Outlined pill under the assistant message, label from bookingActionLabel, e.g. 'Book Laser Rejuvenation · Tue, Oct 27 · 11:00 AM'. Click → close chat → booking.open(treatmentId, { date, time }).
panel.footer_note: AI assistant, may make mistakes. Velure is a demo by Thaus; conversations may be saved. + 'Contact form' link (scrolls to #contact).
panel.behaviour: Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line, ESC closes, focus to input on open and back to the launcher on close, history and sessionId in sessionStorage (velure_chat_session, velure_chat_messages), scroll area has data-lenis-prevent.

workflows.n8n/velure_chat_booking_link_workflow.js: Velure Chat — Booking Link — validates the Book button
workflows.n8n/velure_chat_contact_request_workflow: Velure Chat — Contact Request — Velure Leads (Source 'Chat assistant') + owner email + auto-reply

notion.page: Velure Med Spa — CRM / Velure AI Assistant
notion.knowledge_base: Knowledge Base page — facts only, callouts are ignored. Booking ids must match src/lib/treatments.ts.
notion.system_prompt: System Prompt page — only the code block is used; {{KNOWLEDGE_BASE}} is replaced; no other curly braces.
notion.chat_logs: Velure Chat Logs database (Message, Full message, Reply, Action, Tools, Session ID, Created).

n8n.availability_rules: Same as booking: America/Phoenix, Mon–Sat, 09:00–18:00 starts every 30 min, tomorrow to +60 days. A slot is taken when a booking with Status = Confirmed has that Slot key. Tool checks at most 5 open days per call.
n8n.date_context: The AI Agent system message appends the current Scottsdale date/time and the next 8 dates on every call (not cached), so 'this Friday' resolves correctly.

env.N8N_CHAT_SECRET: server only — same value as the n8n Header Auth credential 'Velure Chat Secret' (header X-Velure-Secret)
env.NEXT_PUBLIC_N8N_AVAILABILITY_WEBHOOK: https://<n8n>/webhook/velure-availability (optional: without it the form only uses the 409 check)
env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL / UPSTASH_REDIS_R: optional, recommended (KV_REST_API_* also accepted). Can share the Thaus Upstash store; keys are prefixed velure:chat:*
env.CHAT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: optional, comma-separated extra origins for a custom domain (with and without www)

acceptance: npm run build passes with zero TypeScript and ESLint errors.
Launcher hidden over the hero, visible after scrolling, hidden while the booking panel is open.
'What's free this week?' returns real free times from Notion and a Book button; clicking it opens the panel with treatment, date and time filled in.
Taken times are struck through in the panel as soon as a date is chosen.
The assistant never claims a booking is made and never shows a Book button without a successful suggest_booking call.
A medical-suitability question gets no individual advice; the assistant offers a consultation and a contact request; the request lands in Velure Leads with Source 'Chat assistant'.
POST /api/chat without an allowed Origin returns 403.
Reduced motion: no launcher or panel animation; mobile 375px: full-screen sheet, input above the keyboard.
